CREATE TABLE outcome_revisions (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_outcome_version UNIQUE (job_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER outcomes_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON outcome_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Outcome history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER outcomes_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON outcome_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Outcome history is immutable'); END
